fact_text: The analyst ties Pakistan's bull-market framework to dollar reserves: healthy reserves make devaluation less likely, and an oil-driven inflation rise is seen as too small to push interest rates out of control.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's rule is to stay invested while the bull framework is on, and in a multi-year bear market with falling valuations and interest rates rising above about 15%, to shift into money-market funds and return to stocks once the framework turns back on.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst names two value-adds on top of regular investing: choosing undervalued companies with strong long-term ROIC and better business models, and shifting between stocks and money-market funds by the bull-market framework.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Compounding at 25% a year rather than 17% over ten years turns an initial 10 lakh into roughly 1 crore instead of about 50 lakh, which the analyst uses to show the value of better company selection.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When picking three or four stocks from a shortlist of seven or eight, the analyst says to diversify across sectors, including some that gain from high oil prices and some that gain when oil falls.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects approval hurdles for the new auto policy draft: the sales-tax treatment of luxury vehicles above about one crore against 18% sales tax on essentials could draw IMF objections and push the decision to the next budget.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The draft auto policy proposes keeping the sales tax on electric vehicles at 1% and keeping sales tax on plug-in hybrid and related models in single digits, which would lower prices and lift sales if approved.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst sees Sazgar (and the Haval brand it assembles) as a good investment if the auto policy is approved with lower sales-tax rates, because lower prices would boost sales and profits; otherwise the analyst suggests waiting for much cheaper valuations.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Under the 2016 auto policy, imports of CKD kits enjoyed a 20% duty relaxation for the first five years, 2021 to 2026.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The 20% duty relaxation on CKD kit imports expired in June 2026.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Assemblers stockpile extra CKD kits just before a duty relaxation expires, and those kits are used in deliveries over the following months, so the stockpiling can depress earnings in the expiry quarter if car volumes stay flat.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Many new car brands entering the market have started a price war, especially in new-energy vehicles, as brands use attractive pricing to win share, which squeezes margins for some makers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When a tax rise on hybrid and plug-in hybrid cars was passed in a budget, automakers did not raise prices; the analyst reads that as a sign of intense competition that forces makers to give up profit margin.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Auto-policy delays and duty changes mainly affect passenger cars, not trucks and tractors, so truck makers are less exposed to the same policy risk.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mari Energies is a beneficiary of high oil prices, so its earnings tend to rise when oil prices rise.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The raw material for paracetamol is linked to oil prices, so when oil stays high, the cost of making paracetamol rises and pharmaceutical makers' profits can shrink.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'How to Turn Market Corrections Into Long-Term Opportunities' (YouTube transcript, undated)
